records.title: KAI FORM 10Q 3Q 2025
records.text: Consolidated revenue was $271.6 million in both the third quarters of 2025 and 2024.

records.title: KAI FORM 10Q 3Q 2025
records.text: Our consolidated bookings increased 3% to $763.9 million in the first nine months of 2025 compared to the first nine months of 2024, driven by increased demand for our parts and consumables products.

records.title: KAI FORM 10Q 3Q 2025
records.text: Demand for our capital equipment products was flat compared to the first nine months of 2024 as market uncertainty has impacted our customers' capital investment decisions.

records.title: KAI FORM 10Q 3Q 2025

records.title: KAI FORM 10Q 3Q 2025
records.text: Net income decreased to $28.1 million in the third quarter of 2025 from $31.9 million in the third quarter of 2024 primarily due to a $6.4 million decrease in operating income, offset in part by a $2.4 million decrease in interest expense and a $0.2 million decrease in provision for income taxes (see discussions above for further details).
